explanation: Extreme 100:1 mass ratio (20 vs 0.2) with e=1 at zero gravity ping-pongs the light body between the heavy body and the arena wall. Each heavy-light-wall cycle injects a small impulse/positional-correction error (light-body speed grows from ~59 after first impact to ~256-287 by steps 1100-1126), accumulating to a ~10% net energy gain, exceeding the energy_bound tolerance with no controller work to account for it.
